name: Mission Super Soft White Flour Tortillas (Taco Size)
whyItWorks: Pliable, tender, and made of refined bleached wheat flour. They wrap smoothly without cracking and contain only 1g fiber, providing a far safer taco/burrito wrap than abrasive fried corn shells.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Warm on a dry skillet for 15 seconds per side to make them extra soft and pliable. Fill with shredded chicken breast and mild cheese.
watchOuts: Far easier to digest during flares than crunchy hard taco shells.
